thread:
Mina (CS): quick weekly sync for SeaGlass — focusing on cache & batching health. Usage spiked after onboarding 3 teams; they reported higher spend. Can we triage hit-rate and batching behavior?
Diego - Solutions: noted. quick baseline from logs (last 7d): hit_rate=38% (-7ppt wk), avg_batch_size=2.8 (-0.4), cost_per_1k_tokens=$0.92 (+18%), p95_latency=310ms (+60ms). error_rate steady ~0.4%.
Priya (Eng): thanks. any infra changes? Last infra deploy touched caching TTL defaults 5m -> 3m for memory pressure. That could explain hit drop.
Mina (CS): SeaGlass is on a trial/POC and they use a lot of repeated short prompts (status checks). Lower TTL will definitely hurt them.
Elliot (Acct): they're sensitive to cost; renewal discussion scheduled in 3 weeks. If we can't show improvements, they'll likely go conservative on usage.
Diego - Solutions: plan proposal: A) route-aware TTLs: increase TTL for /status-check and /small-query to 10m; B) adaptive batching: group small-token requests into a dedicated batcher with batch_target=6 and max_wait_ms=60; C) offer a temporary cost-credit while we tune for their renewal. Which to prioritize?
Priya (Eng): sequence: quick TTL override (low risk) -> adaptive batcher canary -> quantized fallback if needed. For adaptive batcher we'll need a short canary and metrics: batch_fill_ratio, queued_latency, and downstream p95.
Mina (CS): agree. let's do TTL override first. Diego can you own canary + credit note? Priya add telemetry panels.
Diego - Solutions: owning canary + credit. Starting TTL override flag now: `sg_ttl_override=10m` for SeaGlass tenants. Rolling to 15% sessions. cc @cs-automation for alerts.
cs-automation: Feature flag `sg_ttl_override` enabled for SeaGlass, rollout=15%. Alerts: hit_rate change (abs) > 3ppt, queued_latency > 200ms.
Priya (Eng): added dashboard under CS -> SeaGlass -> CacheBatch with new panels: per-route hit_rate, avg_batch_size, batch_fill_ratio, cost_per_1k (estimated). Added annotation for flag rollout time.
Mina (CS): Diego please capture expected cost impact for Elliot's deck. Quick ask: what's conservative expected delta if hit_rate goes +6ppt and avg_batch_size +0.5?
Diego - Solutions: back-of-envelope: tokens/day ~ 8.5M. If hit +6ppt and batch +0.5 we estimate 6-8% cost reduction. Will compute precise with token logs and attach.
Priya (Eng): starting adaptive batcher canary after TTL results clear (2h). Canary plan: 5% sessions, routes: /small-query, /status-check, metrics: batch_fill_ratio, queued_latency, p95_latency, error_rate.
Elliot (Acct): please share timeline and I'd like a short note for renewal pack showing "engineering actions + projected savings". Even a conservative 5% saving helps negotiation.
Diego - Solutions: will draft note. Priya will post 2h and 24h readouts.
cs-automation: Canary: `sg_ttl_override` at 15% started at 1796009999. Monitoring.
Priya (Eng): 2h check-in - preliminary: hit_rate climbed to 44% (+6ppt), avg_batch_size=3.1 (+0.3), p95_latency=295ms (down 15ms), cost_per_1k tokens trending down. No error regression seen.
Mina (CS): great quick win. Please snapshot dashboard panels and Diego add to renewal pack. Also let's label this a win but keep adaptive batcher plan to push additional gains.
Diego - Solutions: snapshotting and drafting renewal slide. Also proposing a small one-time credit of $1.5k to smooth the renewal. Elliot, you good with that?
Elliot (Acct): ok to propose credit contingent on hitting sustained 5% savings over next 7 days.
Priya (Eng): starting adaptive batcher canary now at 5% for same routes. Flag `sg_adaptive_batcher=on`.
cs-automation: Adaptive batcher canary started: 5% sessions. Alerts: batch_fill_ratio < 0.4 OR queued_latency > 120ms OR p95_latency > 400ms.
Priya (Eng): 4h update: adaptive batcher increased avg_batch_size to 4.2 for canary group, queued_latency median=28ms, p95_latency=340ms (acceptable), hit_rate stable. Estimated incremental cost reduction ~3%.
Mina (CS): solid. consolidate these numbers for the renewal note. Action items: (1) Diego finalize renewal slide + attach dashboard snapshots (EOD), (2) Priya monitor canary and promote at 25% if stable (24h), (3) Elliot include proposed credit condition in negotiation.
Diego - Solutions: on it. tagging for visibility: @cs-automation please create a 7d report template for SeaGlass showing pre/post metrics.
cs-automation: Report template created: /reports/SeaGlass-cachebatch-7d. Will auto-populate after 24h.
Mina (CS): thanks team. closing thread — will post final 24h summary here. :white_check_mark:
